column1: All of the shine is gone
The winds at our back and the tangles are untied
Dolly there’s nothing left to hold onto
Lace your gloves up and get your ass back in the fight
Light a roman candle in my hand
There’s a fine line between disaster and the best laid plans
I think we tapped the wellspring
Sitting there on the backseat just waiting to explode
To my bent and defeated heart
Snakes and tanks and black cats  sulphur stains on my driveway
Snakes and tanks and black cats
